title: Orchestrator rule core
summary: A versioned deterministic rule core evaluates consumption, progress, quality floors, portfolio capacity, and the eight existing budgets; it records auditable decisions and uses bounded artefacts for optional LLM classification.

implementationTasks.title: Decision receipt and shadow adapter
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Implement a pure RuleEvaluation(input snapshot, pinned rule bundle) and an append-only decision receipt in shadow mode. Adapt the eight existing policy owners read-only; do not change their dispatch paths. Include rule identity/version, scope, matched and rejected rules, source and freshness of each signal, derived budget and sentence, pressure terms, candidate and shadow action, loop inventory id, evidence digest, and outcome link. Use RB-S1 delivery ledger when present; report unavailable otherwise. Acceptance: replay decisions are deterministic across restart; the same attempt and rule version produce one idempotent receipt; missing cost price is unknown rather than zero; every policy retains its current hard ceiling and breaker; a sample card receipt is visible through an API. Dependency: AGT-W68 RB-S1 for delivery exhaustion facts.

implementationTasks.title: Bounded decision evidence pack
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Introduce schema-validated DecisionEvidencePack with 32 KiB and 8,000 estimated-token caps, at most two redacted 80-line/8 KiB windows, typed source refs and immutable range digest. Migrate the supervision-loop cli-output reader, PostAbortReview input assembly, and the orchestrator-context use of the multichat session projection to consume this pack. Keep authorized human drill-down to the immutable source interval. Acceptance: oversized and secret-bearing inputs are omitted with reasons; no StepKind.Orchestrator prompt can include a session path or unbounded log; schema-invalid classifier output fails to human review; tests cover stale attempt/fence and log rotation.

implementationTasks.title: Coding admission and measured budget
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Using RB-S1 and RB-S2, add a shadow coding-admission rule. Derive a starting round budget from at least 20 comparable clean completions in 90 days using 1.25 times p90, with cohort and exclusions recorded; fall back to RB-S2 resolution when thin. Compare forecast slot minutes and priced quota draw with fleet and eligible Ready reservations, preserving priority, age, and project fairness. Promote only after replay and operator activation. Acceptance: censored timeouts and anomalous host-load runs cannot inflate the estimator; host ceiling and card override precedence remain; scarce capacity produces a visible defer with next-review time, never a silent card rejection; shadow and active decisions carry source derivation.

implementationTasks.title: Gradient adaptation and post-guard
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Apply the Dossier pressure formula and confidence/value thresholds at material events. Use AGT-W56 trusted route and correctness floor for a next-safe-turn model/thinking downgrade; route any unsupported same-session switch through a fresh bounded attempt. Connect high-pressure no-progress and repetition to RB-S3 checkpoint, RB-S4 continuation guard, and RB-S5 prepared scope-cut gate. Do not silently alter acceptance scope or replenish an existing loop counter. Acceptance: $400 and $2 examples with equal normalized usage show different scrutiny; expensive approved route does not by itself halt; cost cannot lower a floor; exhausted continuation reaches the owned human terminal; every action has a rule receipt. Dependencies: RB-S3, RB-S4, RB-S5.

implementationTasks.title: ORCH-3 rules administration
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Add a workspace Rules page and project overlays using a typed, schema-validated definition under .metadata/orchestrator-rules through the application API. Save immutable versions with actor, reason, diff, parent, activation time, and replay digest. Build a read-only dry run over 30 days or 100 eligible decisions showing old/proposed action, cost, slot use, missing data, floor conflicts, and human reversals; label counterfactual estimates. Reject edits that weaken a hard breaker, host ceiling, A3 authority, or correctness floor, and never auto-apply assistant drafts. Acceptance: version pin survives restart; project overlay displays inherited and effective values; revert creates a new attributed version; dangerous edits fail with a specific reason.

implementationTasks.title: Decision visibility and evidence navigation
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Read AGENTS.md, docs/orchestrator-rule-core/index.html, docs/system/contracts/agent-contract-pattern.md, docs/system/contracts/loop-inventory.md, docs/concepts/orchestrator-drive-to-conclusion.html, and the relevant domain map before changing code. Use the Dossier recommendations unless a recorded operator decision selects another option; record the selected option. Keep git handling in platform-owned steps. Project the canonical decision receipt to task primary statement, timeline, bus, and Result panel. Show rule id/version, signals and freshness, budget used/limit and derivation, actor/deciding model and calibrated confidence where applicable, action, blocker, and one-click immutable evidence reference. Add decidedByModel to the bus producer rather than joining token messages. Use one gate id across header and detail to avoid competing escalation statements. Acceptance: light and dark Playwright screenshots of an escalated card show the exact blocker above the pipeline and evidence opens in one click; deterministic decisions say system rule; bus/timeline/card ids and values agree; no stale statement survives a newer decision.
